- Modeled network visaulizations offer an alternative to observed network data visualizations
- This strategy optimizes the theoretical takeaways that arise from empirical analyses
- It may also further the capacity for desirable principles of network visaulization as well (e.g., confidentiality and replicability)
- This is intended as a complementary (not replacement) strategy for network visualization that prioritizes different purposes
